A forum post citing a weekly nut of $900K was contradicted by another user citing $1.05 million in running costs; the $1.05M figure is used here as the more specific claim. The show ran approximately 19 months, which is a solid commercial run but not a decade-defining phenomenon. Without confirmed recoupment, designation remains TBD.

No explicit capitalization figure or weekly running cost is stated in the available evidence. The show ran nearly two years, suggesting a healthy commercial run, but without confirmed recoupment data a definitive designation beyond TBD cannot be assigned from available evidence.
